exposure: Implementation of a quality improvement program using PDSA cycles
Improved education surrounding the importance of deferred cord clamping (DCC)
outcome: Documented use of the Lifestart trolley
cohort: The study included data from 113 consecutive preterm infants born at less than 32 weeks' gestation.
finding: The quality improvement program significantly increased the documented use of the Lifestart trolley from 10% to 79% and the rate of deferred cord clamping in eligible preterm infants from 17% to 92%.
